Rishi — quick update:

- EdgeBridge (edgebridge.io): provides edge caching and telemetry aggregation. They DO NOT have tenant request/response access in normal operation. They receive aggregated logs and anonymized metrics; tenant identifiers are hashed before leaving our cluster.
  - Attached: edgebridge_attestation.pdf (current attestation, last refreshed 2028-11).
- CacheWave: caching partner used for ephemeral LRU caches in Dedicated customers. For customers who opted into dedicated caching, CacheWave may store encrypted key-value blobs; keys are tenant-scoped but we hold the KMS keys unless a customer brings their own. No plaintext customer data stored.
  - I’m exporting the updated roster (roster_v2.csv) which shows processing scope flags and whether a partner touches payloads or telemetry.

Dataflow: there is one cross-border path for telemetry aggregation that routes to our US analytics cluster for aggregated ML metrics; no raw request payloads cross to the US for EU/UK tenants (we onboarded an onshore fallback for EU). I’ve attached the current diagram (dataflow_diagram_v3.pdf).

I can pull the CacheWave encryption attestation but need 24 hours to request the latest copy — they rotated their KMS provider earlier this year.

Attachments:

Hi Nate,

Thanks for the heads up — attached is our current package and a short summary:

- EdgeBridge: processes aggregated telemetry only. Please see edgebridge_attestation.pdf. No tenant-level request/response data leaves region for EU/UK customers.
- CacheWave: used for selective dedicated-customer caches; data stored is encrypted tenant-scoped blobs and we retain KMS control by default. Latest CacheWave KMS attestation is pending; Kimberly is requesting it and expects to push within 24 hours.

I’ve included the roster (roster_v2.csv) mapping each partner to processing scope and a dataflow diagram (dataflow_diagram_v3.pdf) that highlights residency controls and onshore fallback.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (3 May): share current attestations + roster + diagram (this email). Hub ticket created: LOG-4821.
- By EOD 4 May: CacheWave attestation (if available) or a confirmed ETA + mitigation note (onshore fallback confirmed).

If that works I’ll schedule a short call to walk through any open controls the security team wants to validate.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
